join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !list add|delete|restrict|rename ...

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list add
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !list add <name>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list add mylist
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' added, restricted to subscribers and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list add mylist
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'mylist' already exists. Use !mylist add|delete|get|... to access it.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add mylist oops
send hortbot #foobar [HB] A command or list with name 'mylist' already exists.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add mycommand oops
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'mycommand' added, restricted to subscribers and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list add mycommand
send hortbot #foobar [HB] A command or list with name 'mycommand' already exists.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list delete mycommand
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 'mycommand' is not a list.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list restrict mycommand all
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 'mycommand' is not a list.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list rename mycommand other
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 'mycommand' is not a list.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command delete mylist
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 'mylist' is not a custom command.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command restrict mylist all
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 'mylist' is not a custom command.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command rename mylist other
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 'mylist' is not a custom command.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command editor mylist other
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 'mylist' is not a custom command.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command get mylist other
send hortbot #foobar [HB] 'mylist' is not a custom command.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list add builtin
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List name 'builtin' is reserved.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list add lastfm
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'lastfm' added, restricted to subscribers and above. Warning: 'lastfm' is a builtin command and will now only be accessible via !builtin lastfm


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set prefix +
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :+list add b
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'b' added, restricted to subscribers and above. Warning: '+b' is a moderation command; your list may not work.
